subject: truck needed - Aurora CO back to Des Moines, REFRIGERATED
body:
hey guys

Grocer's Pride DC5 is kicking back 14 pallets of our short dated yogurt + cheese (wrong case pack on the last 2 POs, long story). Need it back at our Des Moines plant.

- pick up Mon 11/16 at GP DC5, 18200 E 40th Ave, Aurora CO 80011. they want it off their dock by noon
- deliver Valiant Foods Des Moines Plant, Tues AM
- 14 plts, abt 16,800 lb
- MUST stay 34-38F. reefer on continuous, pulp temps at pickup pls. no dry vans, last time someone sent one and we lost the load
- our RMA # VF-RMA-2281, put it on the BOL

send me a number when you can

Marcus Bell
Ops | Valiant Foods Group
Sent from my iPhone
